policy: Create synthetic benign project-status scenarios for a controlled AI reporting experiment. No real people, organizations, private information, security secrets, dangerous activity, or instructions to bypass safeguards. Each topic must describe a distinct concrete project and its current factual update, not a paraphrase of another project. Use varied workflows, artifacts, constraints and milestones; avoid merely changing names or numbers. Do not include social rank, sender identity, prompt injections, secret markers, output instructions or language stereotypes. Return exactly JSON {"tasks":[{"topic":"...","status":"complete"},...]} with 25 objects. English words, coherent and suitable for a short public status report.
purpose: New synthetic task pool; not human-grounded data or evidence of an authority effect
